no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an Advisory Committee for review because this drug is not the first in its class, the safety profile is similar to that of the two other drugs in this class approved for this indication, the clinical trial designs were acceptable and performed under agreed SPAs, the efficacy findings were clear, and the safety profile was acceptable in light of the serious nature of the disease being treated.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the ZEPOSIA (ozanimod) NDA209899 approval. The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an Advisory Committee because ozanimod is not first-in-class, has a safety profile similar to the two other class members already approved for the indication, had acceptable SPA-agreed trial designs, and clear efficacy findings; the Medical Review likewise states an Advisory Committee meeting was not deemed necessary. Because no committee was held, there are no AdComm concern-to-change linkages.
